$comment: Fill in `sfx.command` and `music.command` with YOUR fal.ai CLI (or any audio CLI) as argv arrays. No shell is used, so no quoting is needed.
Tokens: {prompt} (full prompt incl. style), {seconds} (target length), {file} (absolute path to write; .mp3), {id}, {kind} (sfx|music), {loop} (true|false).
Your CLI must write the audio to {file}. If it only prints a URL, wrap it in a small script that downloads to {file} and put that script here.
The flags in `shape` are placeholders, not real flags. Learn the real ones from your CLI's --help (the generate-media skill does this).
